Functional_Area: Private secretarial / stenographic support to the Commission
Mode_of_Application: Offline / by post through proper channel
Detailed_Eligibility: Principal Private Secretary (Level 11 in the pay matrix) — No. of post: 01. Eligibility Criteria: Stenographers of the Central Government/State Governments/Union territory Administrations/Public Sector Undertakings/Universities/Recognised Research Institutions/Semi Government or Autonomous Bodies or Statutory Organisations: (a) (i) holding analogous posts on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or (ii) with five years service in the grade rendered after appointment thereon on regular basis in Level-10 in the Pay Matrix or equivalent in the parent cadre or department; or (iii) With six years service in the grade rendered after appointment thereon on regular basis in Level-8 in the Pay Matrix or equivalent in the parent cadre or department. Note 1 (for S. No. 1 & 2): The departmental officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion shall not be eligible for consideration for appointment on deputation. Similarly, deputationists shall not be eligible for consideration for appointment by promotion. Note 2: Period of deputation (including short term contract) including period of deputation (including short term contract) in another ex-cadre post held immediately preceding this appointment in the same or some other organization or department of the Central Govt. shall ordinarily not to exceed four years. Note 3: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation including short term contract shall be not exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications. Note 4: Only officers from Central or State Governments or Union territories will be considered for absorption.
Additional_Details: Total 5 vacancies advertised across three posts (Sr. PPS-02, PPS-01, Hindi Translator-02). Advertisement No. Admn-15014/1/2021-ADMN-CIC. Mode: Deputation (including short term contract)/absorption. Application to be sent in the Bio-data/Curriculum Vitae Proforma as per Annexure-I of DoP&T OM No. AB.14017/28/2014-Estt.(RR) dated 02.07.2015 to Deputy Secretary (Admn), Central Information Commission, 5th Floor, Baba Gangnath Marg, Munirka, New Delhi-110067. Application duly filled in should be superscribed 'Application for the post of Principal Private Secretary on deputation or deputation (including short term contract)/absorption basis'. Officers selected will have the option to draw pay plus deputation (duty) allowance or to have pay fixed in the level of the post per DoP&T OM No.2/12/87-Estt (Pay II) dated 29.04.1988 as amended. APARs for last five years (each page attested by an officer not below Under Secretary to GOI), Cadre clearance, Vigilance Clearance, Integrity Certificate and statement of Major/Minor penalties (if any) during last ten years to be furnished by sponsoring authority. Original vacancy notice dated 06.03.2026 (EN 11-17 April 2026); original last date 27.05.2026; extended up to 30.06.2026 vide Extension Notice dated 01.06.2026 (https://cic.gov.in/sites/default/files/2026-06/Notice.pdf).
